issues.where: GX.isSLSCIn_compl_faces_of_locallyFinite (Galois.lean:1430), hypothesis hK; REPORT row rem:simple_cases
issues.problem: Local finiteness is demanded of the family of closed faces in the ambient E (LocallyFinite over E). The proof needs it only at points of |K|: it needs x ∉ closure B for x ∈ |K|, with B the union of the faces not containing x, and every point v it handles already lies in K.space. A combinatorially locally finite complex whose vertices accumulate at a point of E outside |K| is not covered. Example: the segments [1/(n+1), 1/n] on an axis of ℝ², with |K| = (0,1]. The disclosure ('closed faces a locally finite family of E') is accurate, and the row is partial in any case.
issues.fix: Optional. Weaken hK to local finiteness at each point of K.space, e.g. ∀ x ∈ K.space, ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 x, {τ | (convexHull τ ∩ N).Nonempty}.Finite. Alternatively, state it on K.space through the preimages of the faces. Otherwise keep the disclosure.

It has 0 sorry, only the standard axioms (no Paths sorry is reached) and no name clash among its 106 declarations. All 13 labels of l.1417-1559 are reported consistently. The four marks (def:automorphisms_spread, rem:galois_quotient, lem:branched_covering_group_automorphisms, cor:branched_covering) are justified, and the nine reading-dependent or corrected rows are partial and unmarked, with their readings, added hypotheses and findings recorded. No new ruling (DECISIONS.md ends at DEC-48) changes this.
